title: IMRep orientations are a.e. unit: |ξ(x)(β)| ≤ ‖β‖
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n). Then for Hⁿ⌞M-almost every x (i.e. μHE[n].restrict R.carrier-a.e.), every n-covector β ∈ Covector(ℝ^P, n) satisfies |ξ(x)(β)| ≤ ‖β‖, where ‖β‖ is the operator norm of β as a continuous alternating map.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x β| ≤ ‖β‖
